articles.title: PBMs Expand Innovative Plan Designs to Address Women’s Health Disparities
articles.summary: Pharmacy benefit managers are increasingly introducing targeted clinical programs and benefit designs aimed at closing gender-specific healthcare gaps. For self-funded employers, these offerings present new opportunities to enhance health equity and manage long-term specialty and chronic care costs.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Fri, 09 Oct 2026 20:31:51 GMT

articles.title: Hospital Industry Sues to Block HHS 340B Rebate Pilot
articles.summary: The hospital industry has filed a renewed lawsuit attempting to block the Department of Health and Human Services' 340B rebate pilot program. This ongoing legal battle is significant for self-funded employers and PBMs monitoring 340B drug pricing reform, network dynamics, and regulatory shifts impacting drug costs.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Healthcare; Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:20:00 GMT

articles.title: Drug Transparency Shifts From Compliance to Strategic Advantage for Self-Funded Plans
articles.summary: Drug transparency in the pharmacy benefits space has evolved beyond a mere regulatory compliance checklist into a core strategic driver for employers. Self-funded plan sponsors are leveraging transparency data to actively optimize benefit design, evaluate PBM contracts, and control soaring drug costs.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Channels; Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:30:00 GMT

articles.title: Connecting Pharmacy Strategy to Total Cost of Care for Self-Funded Plans
articles.summary: Benefits leaders are increasingly looking beyond isolated drug spend to evaluate how pharmacy benefits impact total medical costs. For self-funded employers, optimizing specialty drug management and clinical integration is critical to controlling overall health plan expenditures. This holistic view reinforces the value of PBM models that align pharmacy strategy with broader clinical outcomes.

articles.title: Navigating GLP-1 Access and Prior Authorizations for Employers
articles.summary: This AJMC discussion with Dr. Amanda Velazquez explores clinical strategies for managing GLP-1 access and prior authorization challenges. It offers insights into how self-funded employers can better structure utilization management to balance escalating specialty costs with member access.

articles.title: NAM Report Highlights Hospital Profits under 340B Drug Pricing Program
articles.summary: A new report from the National Association of Manufacturers highlights significant hospital profits generated through the 340B drug pricing program. This issue is of direct strategic importance to self-funded employers and PBMs monitoring 340B reform efforts and their broader impact on commercial healthcare costs and drug supply chain economics.
articles.source_line: Source: National Association of Manufacturers - NAM; Fri, 09 Oct 2026 20:14:30 GMT

articles.title: AHA Lawsuit Challenges Manufacturer 340B Rebate Models
articles.summary: The American Hospital Association and other healthcare organizations have filed a lawsuit to halt manufacturer-implemented 340B rebate programs. This legal challenge is significant for self-funded employers and PBM stakeholders monitoring how 340B drug pricing mechanics, contract pharmacy operations, and drug discount flows impact overall pharmaceutical supply chain costs.
articles.source_line: Source: American Hospital Association; Fri, 09 Oct 2026 18:58:35 GMT
